deployedFormalPath.effect: For ok candidates only, consensus with >=2 sources adds 0..7 points to priorityScore and records marketConsensusScore/Sources/Bonus.
deployedFormalPath.comparator: post-consensus priorityScore -> rewardPerRisk -> marketConsensusScore -> setupQuality -> sectorFlow -> relativeStrength

shadowPath.selected: Receives selected item derived from post-consensus scored list.
shadowPath.qualifiedNotSelected: Receives post-consensus item from scored list.
shadowPath.nearMiss: Re-runs bare scoreCandidate; result is rejected, so consensus would not have been applied in Formal either.
shadowPath.rejectedAfterBase: Re-runs bare scoreCandidate; result is rejected, so consensus would not have been applied in Formal either.
shadowPath.broadControl: Re-runs bare scoreCandidate for every sampled control.

structuralMismatch.trigger: A Formal-ok symbol is not serialized into SELECTED/QNS because of bounded sampling, remains BROAD_CONTROL-eligible under current used-set semantics, and is selected by broad-control hash.
structuralMismatch.result: The symbol's BROAD_CONTROL snapshot is built from bare scoreCandidate instead of its actual same-date post-consensus scored item.
corruptedResearchFields: ranking.priorityScore can be base score rather than deployed post-consensus score
ranking.marketConsensusScore can be null/0 instead of observed value
ranking.marketConsensusSources can be 0 instead of observed count
ranking.marketConsensusBonus can be 0 instead of observed bonus
ranking provenance label claims FORMAL_PRIORITY_SCORE_BASE_V1_PLUS_MARKET_CONSENSUS_7_5_30 even though the item did not receive the overlay

fixedSyntheticWitness.conclusion: Same PIT feature row can carry different ranking provenance solely because Shadow re-runs the pre-consensus scorer after cohort sampling.

scopeGuard: This does not alter Formal selected names; it is a research snapshot fidelity defect.
Rejected rows are not affected by missing consensus overlay because applyMarketConsensus returns rejected results unchanged.
The defect is concentrated in Formal-ok symbols that spill from bounded QNS into BROAD_CONTROL under current quota-conditioned semantics.
Historical prevalence is UNKNOWN until rows are classified with adequate PIT consensus provenance.
requiredRepair: Freeze one decision-state object per symbol from the actual selector path before bounded research sampling.
Research membership must reference that immutable decision-state object/hash rather than re-running a different scoring path.
If independent broad-market control includes a Formal-ok symbol, preserve its true post-consensus Formal state plus separate control membership.
Persist both formal_state and research_membership; do not infer Formal state from the sampled cohort label.
Add invariant test: for every same-date symbol present in actual scored list, any research membership snapshot must match post-consensus ranking tuple exactly.
If the formal decision-state object is unavailable, ranking provenance is UNKNOWN rather than recomputed with a partial path.
